text:
anya: Hey team — quick design review request for private setup wizard prereq stepper. Thinking of adding small breadcrumb counters that show 'passing/total' for network checks (e.g., 3/5) and a red badge when there are failing checks. Screenshot attached. :eyes: sanjay: Love the idea. One question — do we show counts on every breadcrumb or only on the 'Network' step? Also accessibility-wise we should expose the same info via screen-reader text, not only visual. ryan: Feasible. Implementation note: checks run async, so we'll need an aria-live region to announce updates. Proposal: ```
Network checks: 3 passed, 2 failed
``` Also would prefer counters be text (not images) so they scale. lexi: QA: screen readers will announce each update — that can be noisy. Collapse updates into a single phrase and only announce when the final status changes (e.g., from 'running' to 'complete'). Also ensure focus doesn't jump when the badge changes. a11y-bot: Auto-check: current amber pill (#D98A00) vs bg (#F6F7F9) → contrast 3.4:1 for 12px text. WCAG AA fails. Suggest #B46A00 or use 14px bold. anya: Good catch. For copy, thinking: '3 checks passed • 2 failed' inline, and for the step detail header: '2 failing checks — view details'. For CTA use 'View failing checks' with aria-controls linking to the failure list. sanjay: I vote to only show the numeric counter on the Network and Firewall breadcrumbs (where count matters). For other steps, a simple pass/fail dot is fine. ryan: On the backend, we'll stream incremental results — frontend should show a skeleton and then replace with counters. If we add tooltip, keep it lightweight: '3 passed / 2 failed (click for details)'. lexi: Acceptance criteria for QA: - counters render within 200ms after final status - sr-only announcement occurs once per step change - contrast and font-size meet AA - failing list keyboard focusable and has skip link anya: Next steps: I'll update mock with darker amber and revised copy, add aria-live implementation notes, and drop a small tooltip variant. Assigning follow-ups: @ryan to confirm render perf, @lexi to add qa tests. Thanks! :raised_hands:
